The relocated value in tmpbuf (which may contain uninitialized bytes from the union) is written back into the target section data, propagating the uninitialized value into the in-memory ELF section.

dwarf_begin_elf reads the (now relocated) debug sections; the uninitialized bytes in the section data are subsequently read by DWARF parsing code, triggering the MemorySanitizer use-of-uninitialized-value report.
